## Libs

```{r,libs}

  library("GSVA")
  library("edgeR")
  library("kableExtra")
  library("gplots")
  library("fgsea")
  library("beeswarm")

```

## Load gene expression data

From GEO https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE158420
GSE158420_counts.txt.gz

Data was cleaned according to another script `GSE158420_geneexpression_prep.Rmd`

```{r,loaddat}

x <- readRDS("GSE158420_counts_fixed.rds")

x[1:6,1:5]

```

## 1. Filter low-expression genes and normalise

```{r,filt_normalise}

y <- DGEList(counts = x)
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
y[1:6,1:5]

```

## 2. Calculate log-CPM expression values

```{r,logCPM}

expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
expr[1:6,1:4]

## 3. Obtain reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gmt_import <- function(gmtfile) {
    genesetLines <- strsplit(readLines(gmtfile), "\t")
    genesets <- lapply(genesetLines, utils::tail, -2)
    names(genesets) <- unlist(lapply(genesetLines, head, 1))
    attributes(genesets)$originfile <- gmtfile
    genesets <- genesets[lapply(genesets,length)>0]
    if( any(duplicated(names(genesets))) ) {
        warning("Duplicated gene sets names detected")
    }
    genesets
}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

```

## 4. Run GSVA

```{r,run_gsva}

param <- gsvaParam(
    expr = expr,
    geneSets = gs,
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500
)

scores <- gsva(param)

dim(scores)
scores[1:6,1:5]

```

## Samplesheet

```{r,samplesheet}

ss <- as.data.frame(colnames(x))
rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
ss$patient <- factor(gsub("T","",gsub("N","",gsub("X","",ss[,1]))))
ss$tumor <- factor(grepl("T",ss[,1]))
ss[,1]=NULL
head(ss)

```


## Differential expression with edgeR

No adjustment for patient-of-origin effects.

```{r,edgeR1}

design <- model.matrix(~ tumor, data = ss)

fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

results <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    coef = "tumorTRUE",
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(results)

```

Now with adjustment.

```{r,edgeR1}

design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ss)

fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

results <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    coef = "tumorTRUE",
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(results)

```
